cases.comparison: A real procps reference and candidate must display the error, remain alive and quiet before the recorded x write, then exit with procps status 8; an early exit leaves the key step unreached.
cases.oracle: Pinned Debian procps 4.0.4 watch and procps watch(1): semantic screen positions and rendition, documented error text/status and terminal restoration. Hostname/time are patterned, never fixed to a host.
cases.purpose: -e displays the reference error text and waits for a key before returning procps 4.0.4 status 8.

contains: command exit with a non-zero status, press a key to exit
